title: Daily O-D Pairs
description: One row of Replica's "Daily O-D Pairs" dataset. Derived from the published schema table at https://documentation.replicahq.com/docs/daily-o-d-data.

geoid_origin.description: The ID of the geographic feature where the trips originate. If the feature is a Census geography, this field will contain its FIPS code.

geo_name_origin.description: The name of the geographic feature where the trips originate.

geoid_destination.description: The ID of the geographic feature where the trips terminate. If the feature is a Census geography, this field will contain its FIPS code.

geo_name_destination.description: The name of the geographic feature where the trips terminate.

date.description: The date at which OD counts are estimated in the format YYYY-MM-DD. Similar to the hour, this date is reported in local time at the centroid of the starting H3 cell.

trips.description: The estimated daily OD count for the selected start and end geography on the estimation date.
